title: Send personal note to Mauro De Gennaro: preferredLanguages vs JMAP account settings (drafted, not sent)
description:
Personal note to Mauro De Gennaro (Stalwart; mail-sharing and metadata drafts; owns the IETF 126 action on JMAP account settings, on the IETF 127 AOB agenda with Hans-Joerg) about the overlap between `preferredLanguages` in draft-atwood-jmap-updates-00 and the account settings work. Drafted 2026-11-15. NOT SENT; needs Mark's explicit approval. Ideally send BEFORE Thursday's session, after the list email (jmap-chat-spec-0577). Replace LIST-THREAD-URL. Consider cc'ing Hans-Joerg once his address is confirmed (not in the local spec library).

---------------------------------------------------------------------
From: Mark Atwood <mark@reviewcommit.com>
To: Mauro De Gennaro <mauro@stalw.art>
Subject: Account language preference: overlap with JMAP account settings

Hi Mauro,

I saw that JMAP account settings is on Thursday's agenda. My new
draft, draft-atwood-jmap-updates-00 (LIST-THREAD-URL), defines an
account-level `preferredLanguages`: a list of language tags that a
server MAY use for text it writes with no request in progress, such
as push notification text. For now it's a read-only member of the
account capability, and how it's set is left open.

That's an account setting, so it may belong in your work rather than
mine. If account settings will have a general place for user
preferences, I'd rather drop my definition and point to yours.

The same draft also makes Principal name and description localizable
(RFC 9670), which touches the sharing work. As a Stalwart implementer,
your view on whether the localization model is easy to implement
would be very useful.

Thanks,
Mark
